scope: Bounded source-only ordinary attackV2 latency/owner-observer scheduling review; no capacity limit adjudication.

findings.fact: Typed Attack is executed synchronously. The browser result is not sent at the launch decision: execution returns, then identity/registration processing and the complete ordinary flush run, then complete(request,admission,identity) and sender.send occur.

The main input branch holds its per-connection serial write gate from6021 through the final typed send. Live Zone output on the same connection acquires a read gate at5319. Current-owner ordered viewport packets are enqueued rather than returned as personal direct responses; observers use separate per-connection gates. Thus observers can receive the launch/hit before owner output, while owner live output waits for the remaining same-input work.

Attack is currently not low_latency, and its default should_snapshot and should_save booleans are true. Its flush sends responses, refreshes external mail, sends an authoritative snapshot, requests/executes a debounced save and refreshes routing before the typed receipt. Request-save can synchronously persist after its1.5s default debounce or64 request cap; checkpoint defaults15s.

The in-process typed path does not independently return an early queue admission receipt: it directly enters the runtime, shared pipeline and synchronous shared-Zone mutex/partition dispatch. The scoped launch observer sees this command raw outbounds before routing, then post-dispatch reward/practice/journey and reconciliation/tail work can continue before runtime returns. The existing900ms client deadline is not a corresponding900ms server execution deadline.

Ordinary typed reply absence has explicit fail-closed branches: pre-dispatch heartbeat failure sends a generic error and continues before classifying AttackV2; authorization panic closes; runtime failure attempts a matching typed error then closes; post-execution identity/registration/flush errors close without a typed receipt; absent admission or failed request/actor completion closes. The socket sender also permits up to10s lock+write time, not900ms. These are possible mechanisms, not evidence any occurred for req367.

covered.label: socket_input.queue_residence
covered.interpretation: Before acquiring input write gate; includes connection plus queued-phase/class sampled at enqueue. Phase indicates what was active when queued, not a unique request identity.

covered.label: socket_turn.input
covered.interpretation: Per-connection entire input turn; includes execution, flush and typed result write.

covered.label: serial_gate.zone_outbound_wait
covered.interpretation: Owner/observer live-sender read-gate wait on its own connection. Matching input/wait durations are compatible with same-input blocking but do not prove which internal substage.

covered.label: session_action.execute/shared_session.predrain/inner_execute/reconcile/tail
covered.interpretation: Execution subdivisions exist, but legacy labels lack connection/request ID. Shared stages include relevant synchronous work/lock waits within their spans.

covered.label: session_action.flush/flush.responses/flush.external_state/snapshot.build_and_send/flush.save
covered.interpretation: Existing post-execute subdivisions; all lack connection/request ID. The final typed complete/send has no dedicated subspan.

limits: record_request is recorded at6673/6677 before the post-execution flush and final typed send, so its request histogram is not ingress-to-typed-receipt latency.

ZoneWork timers start only after acquiring shared Zone mutex in owner-tick paths, and do not measure the entire ordinary command or every mutex wait; short ZoneWork buckets cannot exclude a slow attack input turn.
zone_cadence.total starts after the earlier movement-deadline Zone lock lookup; it is not a universal shared-lock timer.

Slow-stage output is thresholded and emitted on guard drop. Public observedAtMs is collector receipt time, not an exact server execution start/end timestamp. Missing lines do not prove absence of a delay.
Batch response write diagnostics separately expose counts/serialization/lock/feed/flush durations under gateway-response-write, but that prefix is not the current strict public slow-stage projection.

minimalCandidateReview.notRecommended: Adding Attack only to is_low_latency_action is unsafe: flush early return skips external state refresh, save request/checkpoint and route refresh even if should_save stays true. Fast snapshot recognition also differs from ordinary visibility/health/map predicates.
minimalCandidateReview.candidate: Smallest conservative server-side candidate for Root evaluation: keep Attack non-low-latency, serial gate, typed-result ordering, all save/error/identity behavior; only avoid the unconditional per-Attack full snapshot while retaining response-triggered snapshots. If doing so, add GainExperience and LevelChanged to the ordinary snapshot requirement because currently the unconditional Attack snapshot covers them; preserve existing health, visibility, quest and map cases. This does not assert snapshot is the measured bottleneck or promise all receipts under900ms.
minimalCandidateReview.other: Shortening the serial gate alone lets owner FIFO progress sooner but leaves the typed receipt after the complete flush; it cannot alone guarantee the900ms typed result. It also changes bootstrap/epoch/owner-health presentation ordering and is a larger proof obligation.
minimalCandidateReview.requiredNewFocusedChecks: If Root adopts a candidate: ordinary nonlethal Attack avoids only redundant snapshot; XP-only kill/level/quest/visibility still refresh; save dirty/debounce/limit/close unchanged; post-execute errors still fail closed; typed request/actor association and observer/owner FIFO unchanged.

evidenceBoundary.reportedReq366And367Correlation: Coordinator/worker messages only; this source review did not independently read the actualraw/slowstage. Observed observer-before-owner is compatible with the reviewed mechanism, but req367 trace ending before later slow-stage receipt does not establish never-reply or an exact substage cause.
